org.apache.xalan.xslt.util

Class XslTransformData

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.apache.xalan.xslt.util.XslTransformData

  • public class XslTransformData
extends java.lang.Object
    A class definition, that has few XSL stylesheet transformation wide variables that are used while evaluating specific XSL stylesheet instructions and XPath expressions.

    • Field Summary

      Fields 
      Modifier and Type Field and Description
      static boolean m_is_xsl_test_invocation
      Class field, to support Xalan-J's test driver for W3C XSLT 3.0 test suite.
      static StylesheetRoot m_stylesheetRoot
      This class field represents, compiled representation of an XSL stylesheet root object.
      static java.lang.String m_templateMatchDotPatternPredicateStr
      This class field represents, XPath predicate suffix for XSL template definition like xsl:template match=".[..]".
      static XPathArray m_xpathArray
      This class field represents, xdm array values returned from evaluation of xsl:sequence & xsl:evaluate instruction.
      static int m_xpathCallingOpCode
      This class field represents, an org.apache.xpath.compiler.OpCodes value, when evaluating an XPath 'idiv' operation.
      static XPathInlineFunction m_xpathInlineFunction
      This class field represents, xdm function items that are returned from XSL stylesheet xsl:function calls.
      static XPathMap m_xpathMap
      This class field represents, xdm map values returned from evaluation of xsl:evaluate instruction.
      static ResultSequence m_xpathNamedFunctionRefSequence
      This class field is used to return XPath 'named function reference' compiled information from an XSL stylesheet function call.
      static java.lang.StringBuffer m_xpathNodeCombiningExprRhsStrBuff
      This class field represents, a string buffer value which is RHS of an XPath expression like '* except (a,b)' i.e (a,b) and when used with a node combining operator like union (and equivalently '|'), intersect or except.
      static XMLNodeCursorImpl m_xslDocumentEvaluationResult
      This class field is used to refer to a document node, that an xsl:document instruction's evaluation has produced.
      static java.util.List<java.lang.String> m_xslResultDocumentUriStrList
      This class field is used to refer to, list of URI strings processed by xsl:result-document instruction.
      static java.lang.String m_xslSystemId
      This class field represents, an XSL stylesheet document's uri, if available.
